title: Diffusion Meta-Prompting and Steering for Generalizable Foundation Model Adaptation
title_zh: Diffusion Meta-Prompting和引导策略用于通用基础模型适应性改进

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种Diffusion Meta-Prompt (DMP)模型，通过扩散模型来建模已学习提示的分布，从而改进基础模型的适应性和泛化能力。 Prompt learning is a popular method for adapting foundation models, but learned prompts are typically task-specific and fail to generalize to new classes, domains, or compositions of tasks. In this paper, we introduce a Diffusion Meta-Prompt (DMP) model , a framework that models the distribution of learned prompts using diffusion models. Given a repository of previously learned prompts, DMP is trained and sampled without access to the original task examples or task losses, and synthesizes new prompts conditioned on natural language task descriptions. To improve the sampling stability, we introduce a test-time steering strategy for DMP, which uses the best training-selected prompt in the repository as a latent anchor during diffusion sampling, without retraining the DMP or accessing test classes. DMP improves generalization across classification, retrieval and text-to-image generation tasks, supports concept composition and negative prompting without explicit training. It reduces storage and inference costs by over 90% compared to prompt retrieval methods. For composite classification, DMP achieves upto 2.0% average gain over prior meta-learning methods across 55 pairs of datasets with gains as high as 8.5% on specific pairs such as Eurosat and Flowers. DMP also enhances cross-task generalization with ~2-9% improvement for hierarchical classification task. We further provide a theoretical guarantee bounding the expected task loss of prompts sampled from a DMP. Code is available: https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种扩散元提示（DMP）模型，该模型通过扩散模型对已学习提示的分布进行建模，从而提升基础模型的适应性和泛化能力。提示学习是适配基础模型的一种常用方法，但所学习的提示通常局限于特定任务，无法泛化到新的类别、领域或任务组合。 在本文中，我们提出了一种扩散元提示（DMP）模型，这是一个利用扩散模型对已学习提示的分布进行建模的框架。 给定一个包含先前学习提示的库，DMP无需访问原始任务示例或任务损失即可进行训练和采样，并能根据自然语言任务描述生成新的提示。 为了提高采样稳定性，我们为DMP引入了一种测试时引导策略：在扩散采样过程中，使用训练阶段从库中挑选出的最佳提示作为潜在锚点，而无需重新训练DMP或访问测试类别。 DMP提升了分类、检索和文本到图像生成任务中的泛化能力，并支持概念组合与负向提示，且无需显式训练。 与提示检索方法相比，DMP将存储和推理成本降低了超过90%。 在复合分类任务中，DMP在55对数据集上相较于先前的元学习方法平均提升了最多2.0%，在某些特定数据对（如Eurosat和Flowers）上甚至提升了高达8.5%。 DMP还增强了跨任务的泛化能力，在层次分类任务中实现了约2-9%的性能提升。 我们进一步提供了理论保障，对从DMP中采样提示的期望任务损失设定了上限。 代码地址：https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp
